# David Packer Does Not Recommend Heavy Bands For Calisthenics Skill Progression

David Packer does not recommend using heavy bands (15 kg or more of assistance) for calisthenics skill progression, as they create a false sense of progress and dependency. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]

## Details

- Heavy bands create a false sense of progress: when the band is removed, the trainee cannot perform the skill. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]
- People who use giant bands for planche often vanish and never show results; those who follow progressions end up with results. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]
- Using a heavy band for a whole year on a skill leads to tiny progress, while someone doing prerequisite skills makes real progress and can perform other skills. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]
- Light bands are useful only when close to the real skill, as they mimic the movement without creating dependency. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]
- Heavy bands can be used for warming up, but not for working sets. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]

## Evidence

- vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ (David Packer): "i don't recommend giant band at all i only recommend like band yeah and that's because one one key thing is that you can spend um and there's so many examples of people posting their you know reverse planche with a giant band and then they just vanish you never see anything from them again"
- vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ (David Packer): "you see all the guys who follow the progressions like you know front lever pull ups p bar whatever most of them end up um you know with a result to show for themselves"
- vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ (David Packer): "if you're just spending a whole year using bands for planche you could be doing your front you could be your handstand push-ups deep 90 degree hair sample shops you know you're you know you can play with it with your whole body weight"
- vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ (David Packer): "light one's very good like yeah but again only when you're close to the real skill yeah that's my experience"
- vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ (David Packer): "when i say heavy band i mean 15 or more kilograms of assistance okay um i don't i can't i can't think of any no maybe warming up and then but then you use the light band as well unless you want to start doing your working sets with a heavy band no no no"
